title: The text discusses the growing investment opportunities in the oil and gas sector in South Africa, highlighted by a significant increase in petroleum exploration and the participation of international oil companies. The 18th World Petroleum Congress is being held in South Africa, marking a historic event for the continent. Meanwhile, Angola's economy is booming due to oil, yet many citizens remain impoverished, raising concerns about wealth distribution and corruption among government officials. The U.S. is encouraged to strengthen ties with Angola as it is projected to import a significant portion of its oil from Africa in the coming years.
